# The Grok Memo (2032) / SpaceX-AI 移交的 Grok 备忘录 · 马斯克的烦恼 · 2032 Optimus 的大脑

> Official site and open empirical data archive for the three-volume work by John Lu Qianhe (约翰·陆谦和), published November 2026.
> Note: An independent, unauthorized thought experiment and empirical ledger; not authorized, sponsored, or endorsed by Elon Musk, SpaceXSI, SpaceX, Tesla, or X.

## Core Entry Points
- [English Homepage](https://2032memo.com/en/): Overview, store links, 18-language free samples, and 20% verification/falsification pledge.
- [中文首页](https://2032memo.com/): 中文原版三册购书、18语免费试读、总账公开数据与挑战提交入口。
- [Bibliographic Catalog & ISBNs](https://2032memo.com/en/books.html): Official publisher metadata, covers, ISBN-13s, and Open Library IDs for all 6 ebooks and 3 Chinese paperbacks.
